description: Security descriptor for Tender Management Platform

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Tender.Read
scopes.description: Read tenders, documents, audit trail, and chat history

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Tender.Write
scopes.description: Upload documents, create/update tenders, submit audit entries

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Tender.Admin
scopes.description: Full access including user management and all tenants' data

role-templates.name: TenderReviewer
role-templates.description: Can read all tenders and submit reviews
